intro: Professional lighting that lifts a performance, whatever the room.

items.name: Pacemaker
items.tagline: Set the Rhythm. Light Up the Stage.
items.description: An entry-level lighting solution designed for artists who want to enhance their stage presence with a professional lighting setup. Ideal for smaller performances, intimate venues, and emerging artists.

items.name: Extraordinary
items.description: An enhanced lighting experience designed to create greater visual impact and complement an artist's performance. Ideal for concerts, showcases, and performances requiring more elaborate lighting arrangements.

items.name: Showtime Lite
items.tagline: Your Moment. Your Stage. Your Showtime.
items.description: A lighting package designed to deliver an engaging stage experience with a coordinated professional lighting presentation. Ideal for artists and event organizers looking for a polished performance environment.

intro: Visual displays that put the performance in the spotlight.

items.name: Blink
items.description: A visual display package designed to enhance performances with LED screen technology. Suitable for smaller events, performances, and presentations.

items.name: Stardom
items.tagline: Put Your Performance in the Spotlight.
items.description: A screen package designed to create an engaging visual backdrop and enhance the overall presentation of an artist's performance. Suitable for concerts, artist showcases, and entertainment productions.

items.name: Captivate
items.tagline: Create a Visual Experience They Won't Forget.
items.description: A visual package designed for productions that require a strong visual presence and impactful stage presentation. Suitable for large-scale performances, concerts, and special entertainment events, subject to final equipment specifications.

intro: Audio that carries every beat to the back row.

items.name: Your Sound
items.description: A sound solution designed to support artists who have specific audio preferences or production requirements. The exact arrangement and included equipment will be confirmed by Cara.

items.name: Our Sound
items.description: A professional sound package intended to provide artists and event organizers with a coordinated audio solution. The equipment and services included will be determined by the final package specifications.

items.name: Ultimate Sound
items.tagline: Feel Every Beat. Hear Every Moment.
items.description: A sound package intended for performances requiring a more comprehensive audio production setup. Suitable for larger productions, subject to venue requirements and confirmed package specifications.
